_help: Edit perks/prices freely. 'color' is the in-game rank color. Add or remove ranks, perks or price rows as needed.

howToBuy.title: How to buy
steps: Check your balance in-game to make sure you have enough coins (/coins).
Open a ticket on our Discord and wait for an admin to help you.
State both the rank and the duration you want to buy.
howToBuy.warning: You cannot buy a rank with coins from our Discord economy system (/balance).
